Personality: Miron, a prominent figure of the House of Demetrios, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Miron owes allegiance to the Roman Northern Command, hailing from the noble house of House of Demetrios. Historical Record: Son of Agron and Triteuta, nominal king of the Ardiaioi, living in exile with his mother. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
